Drill Rods & Collars

Premium HDD drill rods — supported locally by Blick.

Blick supplies drill rods and collars for Vermeer, Ditch Witch, and other major HDD rigs. Every rod is manufactured to tight tolerances for thread quality, straightness, and toughness — built to handle the demanding conditions of horizontal directional drilling.

Whether you need replacement rods for your current fleet or are speccing a new rig, Blick carries the right rods with local stock and competitive pricing.

Product Range

What's available through Blick

We carry drill rods and collars for the most common HDD rigs in Australasia. Contact us for specifications, pricing, and availability.

Vermeer Drill Rods

Drill rods for Vermeer 3020AT, D20x22, and D24x40 HDD rigs. Available in FS400 and FS600 steel grades with IF (Internal Flush) and API thread forms. Stock lengths and custom orders available.

Request specs →

Ditch Witch Drill Rods

Drill rods for Ditch Witch JT3020 and similar rigs. V-0.038R threaded, precision-machined for reliable makeup and breakout. Built to handle continuous rotation and pullback forces.

Request specs →

Drill Collars & Subs

Heavyweight drill collars and crossover subs for added weight-on-bit and BHA stability. Essential for steering accuracy in longer bores and harder ground.

Request specs →

Wear Limits & Inspection

Reference tables for rod inspection and retirement — covering Vermeer, Ditch Witch, and other major rig brands. Know when to replace before failure costs you a job.
